data.description: 冬装参拜，她在绘马上认真写下给妹妹和朋友的愿望，唯独没写自己；挂绘马时踮起脚尖，晨光落在她永远微笑的脸上，温柔里有一点不易察觉的孤单。
data.promptProse: Maria writes wishes for her sister and friends on a wooden shrine plaque, then rises onto her toes to hang it, smiling softly in her beige coat and thick cream shawl. The medium view includes the plaque rack beside her and the shrine approach behind. Winter morning sun touches her face and the pale wood, with crisp but gentle rack shadows across the long skirt beneath her raised hands.
data.title: 玛夏 · 新年参拜的为家人许愿
